name: iOS FPS Boost
description: A set of toggles that cut rendering work and stutter in levels on iOS.

override-fps.name: Override Target FPS
override-fps.description: Use the Target FPS below instead of the game's own value. Your screen's refresh rate is still the real limit.

disable-particles.name: Disable Particles In Levels
disable-particles.description: Skips drawing particle effects while playing. Usually the biggest GPU saving.

hide-glow.name: Hide Object Glow
hide-glow.description: Hides glow sprites on objects, which cuts a lot of draw work.

hide-trails.name: Hide Player Trails
hide-trails.description: Hides the regular motion trail behind the player.

pause-fps-saver.name: Low FPS While Paused
pause-fps-saver.description: Drops to 30 FPS in the pause menu to cool the device, which helps against thermal throttling.

free-memory.name: Free Memory After Leaving A Level
free-memory.description: Clears unused textures after you quit a level to reduce stutter over a long session.
